firm_data.firm_description: Malaby & Bradley LLC is a law firm with results-driven litigators. They offer a wide range of services, including premises liability defense, general liability, and commercial litigation.
notable_facts: Robert Malaby is a leader in New York Asbestos Litigation.
Appointed to the New York City Asbestos Litigation Case Management Order Committee
Serves as Defense Liaison for the New York City Asbestos Litigation.

email.subject: AI for Malaby & Bradley - built for defense litigators like yours
email.body:
Hi Robert,

Your leadership in New York asbestos litigation puts you at the center of one of the most complex, document-heavy practice areas in the country. That's exactly why we built Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional defense firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on premises liability and toxic tort cases.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
